{1: '1', 3: 'In front of a shop along the Orbital Corridor, roses radiate crimson joy, their brilliant hue matching the female Construct standing beside them.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryQujingkuang.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: "Just as you're about to frame the shot, you realize she's nowhere to be found."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vera', 3: 'Poor little child, are you lost? Need me to broadcast a missing person announcement?', 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryQujingkuang.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1406.jpg', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "Vera's voice comes from behind. With arms crossed, she stands beneath the canopy of a nearby restaurant's patio."}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'Are you done setting up your shot? Then hurry up and finish your task, so we can be done with it.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Holding the camera, you turn sideways and blink a few times in response.'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'What, stared at me too long and got dry eyes?', 4: '1'}
{2: "I'm not just here to shoot flowers.", 3: '26'}
{3: 'Seeing that Vera has no intention of moving, you walk over to the same canopy and gesture with your camera.'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "I don't want to waste my precious time on some assignment from the World Government Association of Art.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'Do me a favor and finish your "mission" as soon as possible.', 4: '1'}
{2: "You don't like taking photos?", 3: '34'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "I don't mind snapping a souvenir while taking an enemy's head. Projecting that at a post-battle meeting would surely make those useless bureaucrats piss themselves.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "But I don't have time to spare for such touristy photo events. I'm busy.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'I know you have no schedule after this.', 3: '39'}
{2: 'There must be another reason.', 3: '40'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "You dare pry into my schedule? How amusing. I'll let it slide this time, but only because it's you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "Fine, if you're so determined to dig for answers.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "I don't take pictures for trivial matters, nor do I have a habit of printing them as souvenirs.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "You attended the military academy. Surely you're aware of the military's security protocols.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Vera', 3: "It's even stricter at Kurono. If it weren't for the fact that a frame's appearance is linked to the M.I.N.D. stability, Kurono would have all their Constructs coated to be unrecognizable.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'Vera wears an indifferent expression, her fingers twirling a strand of her hair. Even in the shadows where artificial sunlight cannot reach, her red hair still blazes like a flame in the gloom.'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "Whatever. I couldn't care less about it anyway.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "Images are always distorted and temporary. A photo's significance is confined to that single moment—its only purpose is to record something that's already gone.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'But photographs also serve to preserve and extend those moments.', 3: '55'}
{2: "It's precisely because those moments are so beautiful that we want to keep their traces.", 3: '57'}

{3: 'Vera reaches out. Her slightly cold fingertips trace from between your brows, down the bridge of your nose, over your lips, before coming to rest at the most vulnerable part of your neck—where beneath the skin, your carotid artery pulses with the rhythm of life.'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'Keeping traces of beautiful moments...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: "There are many ways to leave traces behind, my little Commandant. It doesn't always require flowers and rainbows.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Vera leans forward. The breath simulated by her Construct body feels incredibly real as it falls upon the hollow of your neck.'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'For example... wounds.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'How about I leave some of those traces you want so badly on you?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Wounds eventually heal, but photographs can last forever.', 3: '72'}
{3: 'Vera turns around, fixing you with an intense stare for a moment before bursting into cheerful laughter.'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'Where did you pick up that smooth talk? From some Golden Age salesman?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'Never mind. Hand me that camera.', 4: '1'}

{3: "Her hand moves faster than the echo of her words. In the blink of an eye, the precious camera is in her grasp. Its body now obscures the female Construct's stunning face, leaving only the dark lens pointed straight at you."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Vera', 3: "What? Is my little Commandant upset that there aren't any flowers or rainbows to make it more beautiful?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'You are the most important part of this beautiful moment.', 3: '86', 4: 'We should take a photo together.', 5: '86'}

{3: "Vera doesn't respond immediately. Her gaze remains fixed on the display with an intensity that could pierce through the LCD screen. Then suddenly, she smiles, and her fingers swiftly tap out a few commands."}
{2: 'Vera', 3: 'Hmm... I suppose it does have its merits.', 4: '1'}
{3: "With exceptional dynamic vision, you barely make out her commands—she's transferring the photo to another terminal while deleting the local data."}
{2: "What's wrong?", 3: '117', 4: 'Why are you deleting it?', 5: '117'}

{2: 'Vera', 3: 'Since it can\'t meet the "mission" requirements, it\'s just defective data. Can\'t let such sensitive intel leak out. After all, operational security is the first lesson we learned as soldiers.', 4: '1'}
